author: Seung Wook
problem: lap_times lists a kart driver's lap times in seconds, in the order driven, with laps numbered from 1. Return the number of the fastest lap (the earlier lap on a tie), or None if no laps were driven.
bug_description: Uses enumerate(lap_times) instead of enumerate(lap_times, 1), so it returns the 0-based position rather than the lap number.

comments.accurate: Number of the quickest lap, keeping the earlier lap on a tie
comments.wrong_behavior: Position of the quickest lap in lap_times, earliest on a tie
comments.wrong_location: Lap numbering verified; check a tie keeps the earlier lap
